content: This significant improvement validates our method of applying boundary assembling to the segmented sentences, which results in more accurate word segmentation and better semantic understanding. Sentences in the PKU corpus are often segmented into the smallest word units. This results in too fragmented information and incorrect lexical units when input into a named entity recognition model, although this may benefit some other natural language process tasks. By applying the boundary assembling method, sense group in a sentence is better preserved. The downstream NER model can then take advantage of this, improving its result.
